'''Nira''' was a part of the [[Umbaran commando]]'s [[crystal guard]]<ref name="Scars" /> from [[3634 BBY]] to [[3629 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.4}}</ref> and beyond. When she first became a guard in 3634 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]], she transported [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] through the [[void forest]] with two squads and a [[Nira's superior|superior]]. In the middle of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]], the [[Train/Legends|train]] transporting the crystals suddenly stopped, forcing Nira and the other guards to investigate the area. The forest was pitch black, not even allowing Nira to see her own [[Limb/Legends|hands]] in front of her face. She felt that something was off, and soon after a tech officer in her squad got picked up by an [[slybex|alpha slybex]], went flying through the air, and [[Death/Legends|died]] when he hit the base of a [[Tree/Legends|tree]]. Chaos irrupted, and after the entire squad was dead, Nira decided to run away from the [[Species/Legends|creature]]. She hid for three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before she was rescued. After that incident in the void forest, no crystals were allowed to be transported through that area again.<ref name="Scars" />

Five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Nira was transporting crystals with [[Squad One (Umbaran)|Squad One]], including [[Veesh]] and a [[Unidentified Umbaran commando|rookie]]. She recounted her story through the void forest to them before being attacked by the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Scars" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nira first appeared in<ref name="Scars" /> the short story "[[Trading Scars]]" written by [[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]<ref name="Tweet">{{Twitter|StillNotSam|status/898274643756421120|[[Samantha Wallschlaeger]]|quote=So, um... I'm really self-conscious about my prose and it took a lot of guts for me to write this little short story, so I'm proud I did it!|archivedate=20200814154941}}</ref> and published in the developer blog for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[August 17]], [[2017]].<ref name="Scars" />
